content.short: Amnis Finance is a leading liquid staking protocol on Aptos that maximizes the utility of staked APT assets.
content.description: Amnis Finance is a premier liquid staking protocol natively built on the Aptos blockchain, designed to unlock the liquidity of staked APT tokens. By providing users with stAPT (Amnis Staked APT) in exchange for their deposits, the platform allows participants to continue earning network validator rewards while simultaneously utilizing their assets in other DeFi protocols. Amnis focuses on providing a secure and highly efficient staking experience, featuring a user-friendly interface and deep integration with the Aptos ecosystem. The protocol plays a vital role in enhancing the capital efficiency of the Aptos network, ensuring that users don't have to choose between securing the blockchain and participating in decentralized finance activities.
content.meta: Amnis Finance offers secure liquid staking for APT on the Aptos network, allowing users to earn rewards while maintaining asset liquidity.
